scope: Training step timings in the small-pool pilot are engineering observations only, not a throughput benchmark or full-corpus ETA. Inputs were prepared and reused in advance.
interference: A short separate finite-patch metric audit overlapped part of the first/current arm; do not rank arm training speeds from these numbers. The completed 90-call original DDIM schedule timing probe ran before the fresh pilot, with no overlapping training. Increment-smoothing inference starts after the pilot fully exits.
sampler: The cached six-window overfit pool is intentionally different from full-corpus balanced recording cycles.
